attributes.action: End all legal exemptions to pre-slaughter stunning for animals
attributes.additional_details: Current regulations allow livestock to be slaughtered without prior stunning. Major welfare bodies, including the RSPCA and British Veterinary Association, advise that pre-stunning significantly reduces pain and suffering. Mandating stunning for all livestock ensures consistent, humane welfare standards across the UK.
attributes.background: Amend the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing Regulations to remove religious exemptions, making pre-slaughter stunning legally mandatory for all livestock processed in the UK.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject, which you may wish to sign:

End the religious slaughter exemption and require irreversible stunning
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783423
